raw:
SELECT p.StateBorn, p.PresidentName, SUM(ph.YearEnd - ph.YearHolding) AS total_years_served
FROM President p
JOIN PresidentHolding ph ON p.PresidentName = ph.PresidentName
WHERE p.PresidentName IN (
    SELECT p2.PresidentName
    FROM President p2
    JOIN PresidentHolding ph2 ON p2.PresidentName = ph2.PresidentName
    JOIN PresidentMarriage pm ON p2.PresidentName = pm.PresidentName
    WHERE pm.SpouseBirthDay > DATE '1900-12-31'
    GROUP BY p2.StateBorn, p2.PresidentName
    HAVING SUM(ph2.YearEnd - ph2.YearHolding) = (
        SELECT MAX(state_total)
        FROM (
            SELECT SUM(ph3.YearEnd - ph3.YearHolding) AS state_total
            FROM President p3
            JOIN PresidentHolding ph3 ON p3.PresidentName = ph3.PresidentName
            WHERE p3.StateBorn = p2.StateBorn
            GROUP BY p3.PresidentName
        ) s
    )
)
GROUP BY p.StateBorn, p.PresidentName
ORDER BY p.StateBorn, p.PresidentName;

SELECT DISTINCT p.PresidentName,
       term.term_length AS shortest_term_length
FROM President p
JOIN (
    SELECT ph.PresidentName,
           MIN(ph.YearEnd - ph.YearHolding) AS term_length
    FROM PresidentHolding ph
    GROUP BY ph.PresidentName
) term ON term.PresidentName = p.PresidentName
WHERE term.term_length < (
    SELECT AVG(sub.min_term_length)
    FROM (
        SELECT MIN(ph2.YearEnd - ph2.YearHolding) AS min_term_length
        FROM President p2
        JOIN PresidentHolding ph2 ON ph2.PresidentName = p2.PresidentName
        WHERE p2.StateBorn = p.StateBorn
          AND p2.PartyName <> p.PartyName
        GROUP BY p2.PresidentName
    ) sub
);

    SELECT
        ph.PresidentName,
        ph.YearHolding,

);

SELECT
  t.PresidentName,
  t.YearHolding AS StartYear,
  prev.PartyName AS PreviousParty,
  curr.PartyName AS CurrentParty
FROM (
  SELECT
    ph.*,
    LAG(ph.PresidentName) OVER (ORDER BY ph.YearHolding, ph.YearEnd, ph.PresidentName) AS PrevPresident,
    LAG(p.PartyName) OVER (ORDER BY ph.YearHolding, ph.YearEnd, ph.PresidentName) AS PrevParty
  FROM PresidentHolding ph
  JOIN President p
    ON p.PresidentName = ph.PresidentName
) t
JOIN President curr
  ON curr.PresidentName = t.PresidentName
LEFT JOIN President prev_pres
  ON prev_pres.PresidentName = t.PrevPresident
WHERE t.PrevParty IS NOT NULL
  AND t.PrevParty <> curr.PartyName
ORDER BY t.YearHolding, t.YearEnd, t.PresidentName;

        ph.YearHolding,

WITH HoldingSum AS (
    SELECT 
        PresidentName,
        SUM(YearEnd - YearHolding) AS TotalDuration
    FROM PresidentHolding
    GROUP BY PresidentName
),
EligiblePresidents AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.StateBorn,
        p.PresidentName,
        h.TotalDuration
    FROM President p
    JOIN HoldingSum h ON p.PresidentName = h.PresidentName
    JOIN PresidentMarriage pm ON p.PresidentName = pm.PresidentName
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pm.SpouseBirthDay) > 1900
),
Ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        StateBorn,
        PresidentName,
        TotalDuration,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY StateBorn ORDER BY TotalDuration DESC) AS rnk
    FROM EligiblePresidents
)
SELECT StateBorn, PresidentName, TotalDuration
FROM Ranked
WHERE rnk = 1;

raw:
SELECT PresidentName
FROM (
    SELECT 
        p.PresidentName,
        p.PartyName,
        MIN(pm.MarriageYear) AS min_year
    FROM President p
    JOIN PresidentMarriage pm ON p.PresidentName = pm.PresidentName
    WHERE pm.MarriageYear IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.PresidentName, p.PartyName
) PresMinMarriage
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        PresidentName,
        PartyName,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PartyName ORDER BY min_year ASC) AS rk,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PartyName, min_year) AS tie_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            p.PresidentName,
            p.PartyName,
            MIN(pm.MarriageYear) AS min_year
        FROM President p
        JOIN PresidentMarriage pm ON p.PresidentName = pm.PresidentName
        WHERE pm.MarriageYear IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY p.PresidentName, p.PartyName
    ) t
) Ranked USING (PresidentName, PartyName)
WHERE rk = 1 AND tie_count = 1;

    SELECT 
        PresidentName,
        YearHolding,
        YearEnd,
        RunnerUp,
        LAG(RunnerUp) OVER (ORDER BY YearHolding, YearEnd) AS prev_runner,
        LEAD(RunnerUp) OVER (ORDER BY YearHolding, YearEnd) AS next_runner
    FROM PresidentHolding
)
SELECT PresidentName
FROM ConsecutiveElections
WHERE RunnerUp IS NOT NULL AND (RunnerUp = prev_runner OR RunnerUp = next_runner)
ORDER BY YearHolding, YearEnd;

    SELECT 
        ph.PresidentName,
        ph.YearHolding,
        ph.YearEnd,
        p.PartyName AS CurrentParty,
        LAG(p.PartyName) OVER (ORDER BY ph.YearHolding ASC, ph.YearEnd ASC) AS PrevParty

)

    YearHolding,
    PrevParty,
    CurrentParty

ORDER BY YearHolding, YearEnd;

SELECT pst.PresidentName
FROM (
    SELECT 
        p.PresidentName,
        p.StateBorn,
        MIN(ph.YearEnd - ph.YearHolding) AS min_tenure
    FROM President p
    JOIN PresidentHolding ph ON p.PresidentName = ph.PresidentName
    GROUP BY p.PresidentName, p.StateBorn
) pst
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        p.StateBorn,
        AVG(p_min.min_tenure) AS avg_min_tenure
    FROM President p
    JOIN (
        SELECT PresidentName, MIN(YearEnd - YearHolding) AS min_tenure
        FROM PresidentHolding
        GROUP BY PresidentName
    ) p_min ON p.PresidentName = p_min.PresidentName
    GROUP BY p.StateBorn
) sat ON pst.StateBorn = sat.StateBorn
WHERE pst.min_tenure < sat.avg_min_tenure;

WITH pres_min AS (
    SELECT ph.PresidentName,
           MIN(ph.YearEnd - ph.YearHolding) AS min_duration
    FROM PresidentHolding ph
    GROUP BY ph.PresidentName
),
party_avg AS (
    SELECT p.PartyName,

)
SELECT pm.PresidentName, pm.min_duration
FROM pres_min pm
JOIN President p ON pm.PresidentName = p.PresidentName
JOIN party_avg pa ON p.PartyName = pa.PartyName
WHERE pm.min_duration < pa.avg_min_duration;

WITH ordered_terms AS (
  SELECT
    ph.PresidentName,
    ph.YearHolding,
    ph.YearEnd,
    p.PartyName,
    LAG(p.PartyName) OVER (ORDER BY ph.YearHolding, ph.YearEnd) AS PrevPartyName
  FROM PresidentHolding ph
  JOIN President p ON ph.PresidentName = p.PresidentName
)
SELECT
  PresidentName,
  YearHolding,
  PrevPartyName AS PreviousTermParty,
  PartyName AS CurrentTermParty
FROM ordered_terms
WHERE PrevPartyName IS NOT NULL
  AND PrevPartyName <> PartyName
ORDER BY YearHolding;

    SELECT PartyName FROM Party WHERE PartyName = 'Whig'
),
deleted_president AS (
    SELECT PresidentName FROM President

)

UNION ALL

UNION ALL

UNION ALL

WITH term AS (
  SELECT
    p.PresidentName,
    p.PartyName,
    SUM(ph.YearEnd - ph.YearHolding) AS TermLength
  FROM President p
  JOIN PresidentHolding ph ON p.PresidentName = ph.PresidentName
  GROUP BY p.PresidentName, p.PartyName
)
SELECT
  t.PartyName,
  t.PresidentName,
  t.TermLength
FROM term t
WHERE t.TermLength < ALL (
  SELECT t2.TermLength
  FROM term t2
  WHERE t2.PartyName = t.PartyName
    AND t2.PresidentName <> t.PresidentName
);

WITH RECURSIVE edges AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT PresidentName AS A, VicePresidentName AS B
    FROM PresidentHolding
    WHERE VicePresidentName IN (SELECT PresidentName FROM President)
),
paths AS (
    SELECT A, B FROM edges
    UNION
    SELECT p.A, e.B
    FROM paths p
    JOIN edges e ON p.B = e.A
)
SELECT DISTINCT A AS PresidentName, B AS VicePresidentName
FROM paths
ORDER BY PresidentName, VicePresidentName;
